description: Format edited Python, then run the shared quality checks after edits and before stopping.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; & (Join-Path $r 'backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') (Join-Path $r 'scripts/hooks/quality_gate.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; & (Join-Path $r 'backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') (Join-Path $r 'scripts/hooks/privacy_gate.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
